startView.agents.none.note: The Agents running section when no agent runs.

startView.board.count.note: A project's cards in one column, in the Board section. column: its name.

startView.board.none.note: A project with no cards in Doing, Review, Passed or Todo.

startView.column.text: {column, select, todo {Todo} doing {Doing} review {Review} passed {Passed} hold {On hold} done {Done} other {{column}}}
startView.column.note: A column's name in the view's lines. column: its id.

startView.digest.text: {week} has entries but no digest: write one (kind digest, digestOf "{week}"; the journal skill).
startView.digest.note: A week with journal entries but no digest. week: "2026-W41".

startView.foot.text: More with hive_journal_recall (small first; hive_journal_entry for one in full): the journal skill says how.
startView.foot.note: The state view's last line (#1032): the view is a snapshot within a budget, and recall is how to get more.

startView.head.text: Where things stand, {source, select, compact {after a compaction} resume {on resuming} other {at session start}} ({when} UTC): a snapshot from the board, lanes, agents and your journal. Check the live state before acting on it.
startView.head.note: The state view's first line, after the fixed "[Hive] " (#1032). source: compact, resume or start (Claude Code's SessionStart source; clear and startup are a start). when: the time, "2026-10-18 12:00".

startView.line.asking.text: {agent} ({project}) {status, select, signin {needs signing in} other {waits for the user}}{hasAsking, select, yes {: {asking}} other {}}
startView.line.asking.note: An agent waiting on the user. status: signin when it needs signing in. asking: what it asks (hasAsking: yes when known), cut short.

startView.line.blocked.note: A blocked card waiting on the user. reason: the card's blocked reason, cut short.

startView.line.card.text: {card} {column} · {project}{hasAgent, select, yes { · {agent}} other {}}{hasReviewer, select, yes {, reviewed by {reviewer}} other {}}: {title}
startView.line.card.note: A card in Doing or Review. card: its key or number; column: its name; agent, reviewer: names (hasAgent, hasReviewer: yes when there is one); title: its title, cut short.

startView.line.lane.text: {builder}{hasReviewer, select, yes {/{reviewer}} other {}} ({project}): {at, select, paused {paused on {card}} card {on {card}, {state}} other {{state}}}
startView.line.lane.note: A running lane. at: paused (paused on card), card (working on card) or other; state: the lane's state (active, waiting…).
